issue.title: Wire SyncScreen Pause/Cancel/Sync Now to upload orchestrator
issue.body:
## Summary

`SyncScreen` still has `TODO(#150)` stubs for Pause / Resume / Cancel / Sync Now and mock upload progress state. The upload trigger/sync **engine** landed on `main` via PR #223 (with #100); dedicated PR #213 was closed unmerged, so UI wiring was left behind.

Predecessor: #150 (engine AC complete; this issue is the leftover SyncScreen glue).

## Scope

Wire Sync screen controls and live status to the upload orchestrator imperative APIs in `src/services/uploadOrchestrator.ts`:

- `pauseUploadSession()`
- `cancelUploadSession()`
- `syncNowUploads()`
- `getUploadSessionSnapshot()` (replace mock `status` / chapter counts / `nextRetryAt` where appropriate)

Resume should remain distinct from Sync Now if the orchestrator model requires it; today the screen’s resume path clears via Sync Now — align with orchestrator semantics when wiring.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Sync Now invokes `syncNowUploads()` (or equivalent) instead of only the legacy `useSync` path for upload-session pause-window clear
- [ ] Pause invokes `pauseUploadSession()` and UI reflects paused state from orchestrator snapshot
- [ ] Cancel invokes `cancelUploadSession()` and UI returns to a coherent pending/idle state
- [ ] Resume behavior matches orchestrator (document if it aliases Sync Now)
- [ ] Mock `TODO(#150)` state for status / uploadedChapters / totalChapters / nextRetryAt is replaced with orchestrator-backed data (or explicitly deferred with a linked follow-up)
- [ ] Existing SyncScreen tests updated; unit coverage for control → orchestrator calls

## File pointers

- `src/app/screens/SyncScreen.tsx` — `TODO(#150)` stubs
- `src/services/uploadOrchestrator.ts` — `pauseUploadSession` / `cancelUploadSession` / `syncNowUploads` / `getUploadSessionSnapshot`
- Related UI: `SyncActionControls`, `UploadProgressBar`, `SyncStatusIndicator`

## Out of scope

Re-implementing the upload engine itself (#150). Download-queue / `allComplete` (#149) unless needed for status display consistency.
